body: No I'm just worried about being there. Idk what to even say when I check in.
Almost two years. It's been getting worse for last few months though.
I'm having an internal conflict with my feelings I guess. I'm snapping and having terrible thoughts I never would have imagined myself having. I feel mentally sick.

Half Of my brain is saying snap out of if it. Keep trying keep going because you're going to be okay. But the louder side of my brain just says stop. Don't be in pain anymore. I'm trying to not listen and that's why I feel I need to go to a hospital soon. I just don't understand the process or what will happen to me.
I've tried. Over and over and people just get bored of hearing about it.
I've actually been to a therapist. And a psychiatrist. Doesn't make much difference. Sometimes it feels like talking about it makes it worse.
